mentions.name: FluxMail
mentions.description: A modern, AI-powered email client that uses AI to help users organize and manage their inboxes while keeping control. Focuses on polishing the small but important email client features such as threading, quote blocks, and smart autofill of reply addresses.
mentions.problem: Good email clients depend on many small, easily overlooked features, and the polish of the "last 20%" makes a big difference for an app used for hours a day, but takes a long time to build.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://www.fluxmail.ai, a modern, AI-powered email client.

I think there's a lot of potential for AI to improve the way we organize and manage our inboxes, while still letting us keep control over it.
